All 888 games · complete no-script view
Original and rolling are separate. The 622 original rows are retrospective frozen-recipe replay. This snapshot has no authenticated rolling or genuinely issued new forecast. Future numeric fields stay unfilled until their inputs are verified.
References are useful before they are tradable. We show captured and recovered market information with its actual clock. Trade history, candle close and de-vigged sportsbook probabilities have different meanings. All paper decisions remain NO BET.

Provider coverage, made visible

Every provider is checked against the same observed game inventory. Polymarket US and Global are distinct products.

What each market clock means

Quote time is the timestamp represented by the source. Captured time is when that record was retrieved. A historical record recovered today can support a labelled retrospective market comparison; it cannot prove that our model possessed that information before an earlier prediction.

T−120 and T−60 use observations at or before the stated cutoff. Latest stored before kickoff uses a strictly earlier source timestamp. Latest stored observation may include postgame records and is clearly marked. Catalog prices with an unknown quote clock are shown only in that current-snapshot view, with the actual capture time. Candle buckets crossing a cutoff are excluded. None of these views establishes a continuously observed feed, executable fill, verified fee, profit or betting eligibility.

New market acquisition is independent of model-feature admission. Existing raw-feature validation prevents unsupported forecasts; it does not prohibit collecting schedules, history or market observations. Event matching, source rights and timestamps remain required.

Performance with its denominators

Full-precision metrics come from authenticated owner evidence. Rounded display values do not rescore the models.
